# Notice of Contract Award
## Provision of Apron Cleaning Services at Hong Kong International Airport (PRO/T058/26/HC)
Notice is hereby given that Airport Authority of HKIA Tower, 1 Sky Plaza Road, Hong Kong International Airport, Lantau, Hong Kong has awarded a contract for the Provision of Apron Cleaning Services at Hong Kong International Airport (Tender Ref: PRO/T058/26/HC) to Baguio Cleaning Services Company Limited at Flat/ Room A, 4/F, Dragon Ind. Bldg., 93 King Lam Street, Lai Chi Kok, Kowloon, Hong Kong on 10 July 2026. The estimated contract value for the period commencing from 1 August 2026 to 31 July 2029 is HK$126.49 million.
Procurement was by way of an open tender.

# Notice of Contract Award
## Term Contract T26M202 Maintenance, Improvement and Refurbishment Works for Underwater Facilities (PRO/T196/26/MP)
Notice is hereby given that Airport Authority of HKIA Tower, 1 Sky Plaza Road, Hong Kong International Airport, Lantau, Hong Kong has awarded a contract for Term Contract T26M202 Maintenance, Improvement and Refurbishment Works for Underwater Facilities (Tender Ref: PRO/T196/26/MP) to CLPe Solutions Limited at 36/F, Asia Trade Centre, 79 Lei Muk Road, Kwai Chung, N.T., Hong Kong on 20 July 2026. This Term Contract is for a contract period from 13 August 2026 to 12 August 2030. The estimated contract value excluding price fluctuation for this Term Contract is HK$44.78 million.
Procurement was by way of an open tender with tender notice published on 24 April 2026 on Airport Authority’s website.
